The lighting is warm and domestic.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ground meat mixture baked into loaf form.

The color and viscosity of the topping strongly suggest a tomato-based reduction or glaze.

The greens lack distinct leaf structures and veins, appearing as a matted, amorphous mass rather than individual leaves. This suggests a failure to resolve fine biological details.
The mashed potatoes fade into an indistinct blur at the edge of the frame/plate, lacking the fluffy texture expected of mashed potatoes. It looks more like a painted smear.
